description: The lifecycle runs its gates where the project says tests run

specs.description: harden under test.remote gates each fix on the remote runner and keeps only the fixes that passed there
specs.given: a repository with a bare origin, a fake runner that clones the commit it is sent and sets ON_FAKE_RUNNER=1, and a gate that passes only when ON_FAKE_RUNNER=1 and the target holds no BROKEN line
specs.when: a harden pass with HardenGates.remote set fixes bug-1 well and bug-2 by writing BROKEN
specs.then: bug-1 is committed and bug-2 is reverted; the final gate passed; every gate ran on the runner (its log names each candidate) and none here; no refs/heads/hexa-gate/* is left on origin; the committed tree is a tree the runner tested

specs.description: With a fast gate, each fix's fast gate and each batch's full gate run on the remote runner
specs.given: the same repository and runner, a fast gate with {touched} that also requires ON_FAKE_RUNNER=1, batches of 2
specs.when: a pass with HardenGates.remote set fixes two bugs well
specs.then: both are committed, the batch's full gate passed, and no gate ran here

specs.description: Without a remote, the same gate runs here, where it is red, and the pass stops at the baseline
specs.then: the baseline is red, nothing is fixed or committed, and the runner was never called

specs.description: A runner that does not run the candidate keeps no fix and leaves no scratch ref
specs.given: a dishonest runner that prints another commit id
specs.when: a pass with HardenGates.remote set runs with --no-baseline
specs.then: nothing is committed, a note names the runner failure, and no refs/heads/hexa-gate/* is left on origin

specs.description: An untracked file the operator had before the pass is not pushed to the runner
specs.given: an untracked file secret.txt in the tree before the pass
specs.when: a pass with HardenGates.remote set gates a fix
specs.then: no commit the runner tested holds secret.txt

specs.description: A real cargo-nextest run is counted from its summary
specs.given: the nextest samples in evidence_samples (green: 2 passed, 2 skipped; red: 2 passed, 1 failed, 1 skipped)
specs.then: green is Passed{2}; red counts {passed 2, failed 1} and is Red{2,1} for --expect-red; its first failure is the FAIL line; the libtest lines inside nextest's captured output are not counted again

specs.description: Coloured output reads as the same output without colour
specs.given: the coloured vitest samples (green: 2 passed; red: 1 failed, 2 passed) and the coloured nextest red sample
specs.then: the vitest green is Passed{2}, the vitest red counts {passed 2, failed 1}, the nextest coloured red counts {passed 2, failed 1}; each equals the reading of the sample with its escape codes removed

specs.description: A nextest run of zero tests is vacuous, and a cut-off run counts each test once
specs.given: the nextest zero samples, and a red run cut before its summary
specs.then: both zero samples are vacuous (exit 0) or failed (exit 4) and Vacuous for --expect-red; the cut-off run counts the FAIL test once though it is printed twice

specs.description: A loop gate of hexa spec verify under test.remote costs one remote run and passes there
specs.given: a project with an accepted spec of two passing bash tests, test.remote set to an honest runner, hexa on the runner's PATH
specs.when: `hexa loop stage done` runs with the gate `hexa spec verify <ADR>`
specs.then: it passes; the runner was invoked once; the nested spec verify ran the tests in the runner's clone

specs.description: HEXA_ON_RUNNER equal to HEAD runs the tests in this checkout
specs.given: a project with test.remote set to a template that always fails
specs.when: `hexa spec verify <ADR>` runs with HEXA_ON_RUNNER set to HEAD's full id
specs.then: it passes, the tests ran here, and the template was not called

specs.description: HEXA_ON_RUNNER naming another commit is refused
specs.when: `hexa spec verify <ADR>` runs with HEXA_ON_RUNNER set to another commit's id
specs.then: it exits non-zero naming HEXA_ON_RUNNER and both ids, and nothing ran

specs.description: The batch script exports HEXA_ON_RUNNER for each command
specs.given: a batch script for commit C with one command `printf %s "$HEXA_ON_RUNNER"`

specs.description: stage done refuses with head-not-pushed when the remote does not hold HEAD, though the local tracking ref does
specs.given: a project under test.remote on main, pushed, whose origin then loses refs/heads/main
specs.then: it exits non-zero naming head-not-pushed and `git push`, and the runner was not called

specs.description: stage done refuses an unpushed HEAD with the named code
specs.given: a project under test.remote with a commit not pushed
specs.then: it exits non-zero naming head-not-pushed, and the runner was not called

specs.description: stage done sends the evidence command with the gate, in one run
specs.given: a project under test.remote with an ADR, a gate and an evidence command that prints EVIDENCE-OK and touches a file
specs.then: it passes; the runner was invoked once; the ADR holds EVIDENCE-OK; the file was not touched here

specs.description: loop task done runs no gate, here or remote
specs.given: a project under test.remote with a loop gate that touches a file, and one task
specs.then: the task is done, the file was not touched, and the runner was not called
